en.name: Yishi
en.ability: Each day, you may publicly claim a character is in play. That night, you learn whether it was true. Once you have learned both a yes and a no, you lose this ability.

revisions.v1: Each day, you may publicly choose a character. That night, you learn whether that character is in play. If you learn a no, you lose this ability.
revisions.v2026-08: Each day, you may publicly claim a character is in play. That night, you learn whether it was true. Once you have learned both a yes and a no, you lose this ability.

zh.name: 驿使
zh.ability: 每个白天，你可以公开声明一个角色在场。在当晚，你会得知该声明是否正确。如果你得知过是和否，你失去此能力。

revisions.v1: 每个白天，你可以公开声明一个角色。在当晚，你会得知该角色是否在场。如果你因此得知了否，你失去此能力。
